hooks.name: Route tests through the compact runner
hooks.description: Blocks shell commands that run `python -m unittest` (or pytest) directly, so the suite's raw verbose output never lands in the main model's context. The agent is told to use tools/run_tests.py or the test-runner subagent instead. Commands that mention run_tests.py, pip, install, --version or --help are allowed. Set KIRO_ALLOW_RAW_TESTS=1 or enabled to false to turn this off.
